object.attr: derived: CF-V48 (D-V32). An object ID created on both sides counts twice, so a merge that kept one object, by git or a client, falls short, whoever finished the merge. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V14, open question Q8), to confirm; the mellon-check part is handed to CHECK.
object.description: If the latest commit is a merge commit holding fewer objects absent from its merge base than its parents hold, counting per parent, Mellon shall report the merge commit.
